text:
Emma Chen: heads-up: BridgeWorkis ready to co-launch their OrchStack adapter with our gateway. We need a crisp co-launch plan covering cloud marketplace entries (AWS/GCP), joint blog, and a short demo. Thoughts?
Josh Patel: timeline? theyprefer same-day marketplace listings. do we sync or stagger? :thinking_face:
Emma Chen: prefer week of May 12. plan: same-day marketplace listing + joint blog + 20-min webinar demo. Maria take marketplace assets?
Maria Gomez: I can own marketplace artifacts: listing copy, screenshot for validation, cost estimate, and logos in required sizes (72/300px). will need container/AMI references from eng.
Liam O'Neill: eng will validate adapter contract, auth flows, telemetry. ask BridgeWork for a smoke-test matrix and a sample `adapter.yaml`. also want runtime compatibility table (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
BridgeWork (partner): sending smoke test matrix and logos later today.
Josh Patel: eng deliverables
- container image tags + quick install command
- smoke_test.sh for e2e
- staging demo env and secrets

Example adapter snippet for validation:
```
adapter: orchstack-bridgework
version: "1.0.0"
endpoint: https://staging.bridgework.example.com/api/v1/execute
auth: bearer
params:
  max_workers: 8
  timeout_ms: 60000
```

Liam O'Neill: also need a compat note: tested LangChain >=0.3.0, LlamaIndex >=0.7.2. call out community adapters for older versions.
Emma Chen: marketing needs a 3-step demo script and 3 customer scenarios (multi-model routing, long-context pipelines, gateway failover). I'll draft.
deploy-bot: staging cluster provisioned: https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/orchstack-launch (creds shared in #eng-secure).
Tasha Rivera: legal/PR: prepare embargo calendar. legal needs 72h for copy/trademark review. confirm logo usage permissions.
Maria Gomez: for marketplace entries we also need concise benefits bullets. eng: provide 2 short technical bullets we can use.
Josh Patel: technical bullets: ["One-file orchestration adapter: connect common orchestrators with minimal config.", "KV-aware routing & cache optimization to reduce token spend in multi-model pipelines."]
Emma Chen: risk notes: 1) marketplace approval delays (mitigate with staged publish), 2) adapter performance regressions (mitigate with canary on Dedicated pool), 3) webinar slot conflicts (mitigate with recorded demo).
Liam O'Neill: ops: tag traces with `partner:bridgework` and export spans to our dev tracing endpoint. add metrics for adapter_latency_95 and adapter_error_rate.
BridgeWork (partner): we'll provide sample workloads and an orchestrator demo (Airflow + Prefect).
Emma Chen: action items (owners & due dates):
- Maria: marketplace assets + listing draft (3 days)
- Josh: container tags + smoke script + staging push (EOD)
- Liam: validation checklist + telemetry hooks (48h)
- Tasha: legal/PR intake + embargo calendar (72h)
- Emma: blog draft + demo script + webinar scheduling (5 days)

Josh Patel: I'll push `redwood/orchstack-adapter:1.0.0-rc` to staging registry today and attach `smoke_test.sh`.
Maria Gomez: adding marketplace checklist to shared drive and will ping when ready.
Tasha Rivera: once legal signs off I'll loop in PR and events. keep status updates in this thread only.
BridgeWork (partner): excited to launch we'll send assets shortly :rocket:
Emma Chen: thanks team. keep updates concise here so we can hit the window. :calendar:
